description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Kinesis Video Signaling Channels service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for available functions such as getIceServerConfig and sendAlexaOfferToMaster, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: KinesisVideoSignalingChannelsClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS Kinesis Video Signaling Channels service.

methods.name: getIceServerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves ICE server configuration for the signaling channels.

methods.name: sendAlexaOfferToMaster
methods.description: Sends an Alexa offer to the master for signaling.

methods.name: sendAlexaOfferToMasterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an Alexa offer to the master.
